name.description: Your name, so Jarvis knows who it works for.

server.description: The API server: where it listens, who may call it, HTTPS.

host.description: The address to listen on: 127.0.0.1 (this machine only) unless deliberately opened up.

allowedOrigins.description: Browser origins allowed to call the API. Add this machine's LAN address to use Jarvis from a phone, e.g. https://192.168.1.50:5173.

accessKey.description: The pass-key for signing in. Unset: one is generated and kept in the data folder (access-key).

tls.description: HTTPS: off (under Node, Vite serves HTTPS in front), or self-signed (a certificate made once). The release binary defaults to self-signed.

tlsCert.description: Your own certificate (PEM), with tlsKey: overrides tls.

siteDir.description: The built web client to serve at /. Unset: not served (in development Vite serves it; the release binary sets it).

data.description: Where Jarvis keeps its data and your files.

dir.description: The database, audio archive and everything Jarvis keeps (relative to apps/server). Private conversations: never commit it.

workspace.description: The folder Jarvis's file tools work in (to-dos, lists, notes, …). Default: <data.dir>/workspace.

history.description: Keep the data folder in git, committing every change (any change can be undone).

plugins.description: Which plugins are on (the LLM's tools).

llm.description: The LLMs Jarvis answers with. One connection (url, model, apiKey below), or several in "connections": each agent picks "connection/model".

default.description: With several connections: the model agents use unless they pick one, as "connection/model" (e.g. "local/Assistant"). Default: the first connection's model.

url.description: The OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint (llama.cpp's llama-server, or a hosted service).

model.description: The model name to ask for.

apiKey.description: Sent as "Authorization: Bearer …" (a hosted service, or llama-server --api-key).

vision.description: The model can see images (llama.cpp with --mmproj): photos you add are sent to it.

connections.description: Several LLM connections (when set, the url, model, apiKey and vision above are not used: make your local server one of these).

label.description: What it is called on screen.

kind.description: openai: any OpenAI-compatible host (OpenAI, xAI Grok, OpenRouter, Groq, llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM). anthropic: Claude, through Anthropic's own API.

url.description: Its address (openai kind: required; e.g. https://api.openai.com, https://api.x.ai, http://127.0.0.1:5454).

apiKey.description: Its API key; "${NAME}" takes it from the environment.

model.description: The model agents on this connection use unless they name another.

models.description: The models offered in the pickers. Default: the ones the connection lists.

vision.description: Its models can see images (anthropic: default true).

llamaCpp.description: A llama.cpp server: its token counter and context size feed the context meter, and replies are asked for without thinking.

effort.description: anthropic: how hard Claude thinks (default: the model's own).

contextWindow.description: Its context size in tokens, for the context meter (llama.cpp tells it itself).

extra.description: Extra request fields sent with every request (openai kind).

audio.description: Speech: audio.cpp for transcription and text-to-speech, and the voiceprint model.

ttsVoice.description: Jarvis's voice (agents can have their own).

voiceprintModel.description: The voiceprint model for speaker recognition (npm run fetch-models). Missing: recognition is off.

services.description: Background services Jarvis writes for itself (docs/services.md).

dailyTurns.description: LLM turns services' (and plugins') events may start in a day, all together.

localHosts.description: "host:port" services may reach although they resolve to a private address (a device at home).

scripts.description: Scripts Jarvis runs (the scripts plugin), and the Node.js used for them and for services.

node.description: The Node.js 24 that runs scripts and services. Unset: the first node on PATH.

timeoutSeconds.description: The longest a script may run.

memoryMb.description: The most memory a script may use.

web.description: Web search and the browser Jarvis uses (the web and browser plugins).

searchEngine.description: Which search engine the web plugin uses (see plugins/README.md).

browserExecutable.description: The browser the browser plugin drives. Unset: Chrome's usual place.

home.description: Where you live, used when no place is named, e.g. "Ottawa, Ontario, Canada".

phone.description: The phone line through VoIP.ms: calls, Marvin answering, texts (docs/phone.md).

enabled.description: The phone line on (when the SIP settings are there).

sipServer.description: The nearest VoIP.ms server, e.g. toronto.voip.ms.

callerId.description: Caller ID on calls placed for you (your cell, verified at VoIP.ms). Empty: the DID.

ownerCell.description: Your cell: where Marvin rings you.

apiUser.description: For texts: your VoIP.ms login email.

apiPassword.description: For texts: the API password (not the login password).

apiToken.description: The bearer token from VoIP.ms's API page.

assistantName.description: What the assistant calls itself when it answers the phone.

dailyMinutes.description: Outgoing minutes a day, all calls together.

dailyTexts.description: Texts Jarvis may send a day.

textPollSeconds.description: How often to check for new texts.

ringSeconds.description: How long an incoming call rings your screens before Marvin answers.

telegram.description: Telegram: chat with Jarvis from your phone, and Jarvis messages you there (docs/telegram.md).

enabled.description: Chatting from Telegram on (when the bot token and chat are set; sending works regardless).

botToken.description: The bot token from @BotFather (a bot Jarvis alone uses).

voiceReplies.description: Replies as a voice note too: always, only to voice notes, or never.

email.description: The email plugin: the inbox Jarvis watches and sends from (docs/email.md).

smtpHost.description: The SMTP server (default: the IMAP server).

password.description: The password (an app password where the provider requires one).

historyDays.description: How far back to save mail on the first start.

calendar.description: The calendar plugin: a CalDAV calendar (docs/calendar.md).

url.description: The CalDAV server (the calendar is found from there).

name.description: Which calendar, if the account has several (default: the first that holds events).

reminderMinutes.description: Minutes before an event to remind you (unless it has its own reminder).

pollSeconds.description: How often to check the calendar for changes.
